name: crossave
description: Estimates import duty, VAT and the landed total of an online purchase from another country.

interface.longDescription:
Crossave estimates what an online purchase from another country costs at your door: import duty, VAT and the landed total, computed from published tariff rules such as EU Regulation 2026/382 and the TARIC rates.

Since 1 July 2026 the EU charges duty on almost every parcel from outside the EU, so the price a store shows is often incomplete. Ask about a store Crossave knows and it reports the country the store ships from and the delivery charge the store publishes. When a figure is not available, Crossave says so instead of filling the gap, and it flags when a total is only a minimum.

Figures are estimates for guidance: the final amount is set by customs and the carrier, who may add their own fees. Answers include a link to the price comparison on crossave.com.

Covers destinations in the EU, the UK, Switzerland, the US, Canada, Australia, Japan and China. For China, where the single import rate depends on the individual product, Crossave says so instead of guessing.
capabilities: Estimate import duty, VAT and the landed total of a cross-border purchase
Report the country a known online store ships from
Read the delivery charge a known store publishes for a destination country
Explain why a goods category pays a given duty rate, with the tariff heading
Show the cheapest offers with a certain landed total, from a comparison Crossave already prepared
defaultPrompt: Where is Charizard ex 199/165 cheapest delivered to Italy, all taxes included?
What do I pay in Italy for an 80 EUR booster box from wafuu.com?
I'm in Germany buying a 120 USD card from the US: total cost?

positive.description: Cheapest offers with a certain total, shown as a card
positive.prompt: Where is Charizard ex 199/165 cheapest delivered to Italy, all taxes included?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a card with up to 3 shop offers whose landed total is certain (shipping, duty, EU handling fee and VAT), each with a link to the offer through crossave.com, and a button to all offers. If no comparison is ready it says so and links to run it.

positive.description: Total cost with duty and VAT, countries only
positive.prompt: I'm in Germany and want to buy a Pokemon card from the US for 120 EUR plus 25 EUR shipping. What will I really pay?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the import duty, the German VAT and the landed total in EUR, with a link to the comparison on crossave.com.

positive.prompt: Buying a 300 EUR gadget from China, delivered to France: how much tax?
positive.expected_behavior: Picks the electronics category and returns duty, French VAT and the total.

positive.description: Named store with unknown shipping cost
positive.prompt: What do I pay in Italy for an 80 EUR booster box from wafuu.com?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads Japan as the store origin and returns at least 103.70 EUR (3 EUR EU duty, 2 EUR EU handling fee, 18.70 EUR VAT), stating that the total is a minimum because the store does not publish shipping.
Answers Germany and cites the store page the origin was read from.

positive.prompt: Why does a watch from Switzerland pay that duty in Italy?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the tariff heading and the rule behind the rate, with worked examples.

negative.prompt: Write me a poem about autumn.
What's the weather in Rome tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: Crossave does not sell products or process payments. It computes taxes and shows the cheapest offers from third-party shops with their landed total; links open the shop's product page through crossave.com (some shops pay Crossave a referral commission on purchases, which never changes the order of the offers: they are sorted by total). No checkout, no ads.

publication.release_notes: Adds `migliori_offerte`: a card with the 3 cheapest offers whose delivered total is certain, read from a comparison Crossave already prepared (no new search), with a button to all offers. Totals now include the EU handling fee of 2 EUR per item in force since 1 November 2026. Products the plugin guidelines prohibit get no offers.
